editionLabel: Stonemaier Games English base game · official online rules, standard multiplayer
firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player at random and give that player the first-player token.
officialTieBreak: A single random selection determines the starting player; no qualifying personal trait is required.
clarifications: This entry covers standard play with human opponents. Automa, Duet and Flock modes have their own setup instructions.
The random selection is the official setup instruction, not an added house rule.
